			focus = NAM_pw_development_fund
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_pw_operable_tt
				NAM_pw_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_prewar_service_mandate_tt
				NAM_prewar_service_mandate = yes
			}
			hidden_trigger = { has_global_flag = ADISCORD_south_hegemon_NAM }
		}
		cancel_if_invalid = yes
		continue_if_invalid = no
		completion_reward = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = NAM_pw_development_fund } }
				unlock_decision_tooltip = NAM_pw_release_reserve
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_pw_release_reserve_unlock_tt
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = NAM_pw_strategic_reserve } }
				unlock_decision_tooltip = NAM_pw_harbour_slipway
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_pw_harbour_slipway_unlock_tt
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 5 }
	}
